segments.name: Game Distribution and Related Services
products: So I'm a Spider, So What?
Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest - Rebellion Soul
segments.description: Operates a web-based gaming platform distributing free-to-play games inspired by Japanese animations to global players.
segments.evidence: We are a leading globally accessible, web-based gaming platform, offering players an immersive digital space through our flagship HTML5 platform, G123.jp.

revenueModel.text: Game developers pay service fees by allowing the company to retain a percentage of in-game purchases made by end-users, averaging approximately eighty-eight percent after royalty costs.
revenueModel.evidence: In exchange for using our platform, resources, and services, game developers pay service fees to us by allowing us to retain an average of approximately 88% of the gross in-game purchase amounts generated from a game on our platform after the advance is fully recouped.
